evidence.detail: Queue table has a 'Current' column showing archetype_name (the machine guess) and an 'Assign To' column with the archetypedropdown partial — currently no JS auto-populates the dropdown from the current guess
Dropdown is a <select name='archetype_id'> — straightforward to target with JS
When rule_archetype_id is set, the view pre-selects it in the dropdown; but when only a similarity-based guess exists (archetype_name without a rule), the dropdown defaults to [Select]

triage.fix_sketch: Add a data attribute (e.g. data-archetype-id) to each queue row's <tr> in `decksite/templates/editarchetypes.mustache` holding the current archetype_id. Add a small JS snippet (or extend an existing JS file) that on page load sets each row's <select> to that value unless it was already pre-selected by rule. Optionally add a per-row 'Use guess' button. ~30-50 lines of JS + minor template change.
triage.notes: The archetype_id for the machine guess would need to be exposed in the template — check whether edit_archetypes.py already passes it or if load_queue_similarity needs to return it; archetype_id is available on the deck object already.
